trait.name: Animated
entries: If the object lacks legs or other appendages it can use for locomotion, it instead has a flying speed of 30 feet and can hover. If the object is securely attached to a surface or larger object, such as a chain bolted to a wall, its speed is 0.
When the animated object drops to 0 hit points, it reverts to its original object form, and any remaining damage carries over to its original object form.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the Animated Object remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal object.
